findings.title: UTC date properties shift to the previous day in negative-offset zones
evidence: bokehjs/src/lib/models/widgets/date_picker.ts:70 — minDate applies the same conversion to the serialized minimum.
findings.impact: Python Date properties serialize at UTC midnight. In a UTC−05:00 browser, `getTimezoneOffset()` is +300, so converting 2024-01-15T00:00:00Z subtracts five hours and the ISO date becomes 2024-01-14. The picker therefore displays the default one day early and shifts min_date/max_date constraints a day early too; for example, a Jan 15 minimum can permit Jan 14. The new conversion fixes locally-created selections that round-trip through UTC midnight in positive-offset zones but corrupts the UTC-midnight values used to initialize and constrain the picker in negative-offset zones.
testing_gaps: The supplied integration-test diff is not included, so coverage for negative-offset zones and min/max boundary interaction cannot be confirmed.
